title: Advisor rule thresholds
description: data-pack/advisor/thresholds.json — every tunable number the deterministic advisor rules read (RM-38 WP 2.2). These are JUDGEMENTS, not dated external facts, so the file carries no `as_of` and does not move the manifest's. EVERY key is required and additionalProperties is false: these values live ONLY here (no compiled fallback exists in apps/api), so a pack that omits one must be refused whole rather than silently disabling a severity band. `ADVISOR_RULES` order in registry.ts is deliberately NOT here — it is the report's first-wins dedup tie-break, a behavioural contract rather than a tunable.

description_share_threshold.description: advisor.description-bloat — a tool is flagged when its description is at least this share of its OWN definition tokens.

min_description_tokens.description: advisor.description-bloat — …and only above this absolute description size, so a tiny tool is never dressed up as a finding.

top_tools.description: advisor.description-bloat — how many of a scan's largest tools the rule looks at.

high_scan_share.description: advisor.description-bloat — `high` at or above this share of the WHOLE scan's tokens.

medium_scan_share.description: advisor.description-bloat — `medium` at or above this share; below it, `info`.

overlap_similarity_threshold.description: advisor.tool-overlap — the Jaccard floor for calling two differently-named tools the same tool. Passed to the shared compare matcher.

medium_overlap_count.description: advisor.tool-overlap — `medium` at or above this many duplicated tools; below it, `info`. Overlap is never `high`.

high_waste_share.description: advisor.unused-tool-trim AND advisor.quality-validated-trim — `high` at or above this share of a server's allow-listed definition tokens never being exercised. ONE entry for what used to be two identical constants in two files.

medium_waste_share.description: The `medium` band of the same shared waste ramp; below it, `info`.

suite_run_window.description: How many suite runs a grade-aware rule walks, newest first.

provenance_suite_run_limit.description: How many suite-run ids one AdvisorGradeProvenance lists.

evidence_tool_limit.description: How many `tool_scan` evidence refs a single recommendation may carry.

evidence_run_limit.description: How many `run` evidence refs one side of a run-derived finding may carry.
